physical_model.notes: Roll a standard normal z (e.g. Box–Muller from the seeded RNG), clamp it to ±3, then value = mean + z * sd. Weight and length share one z per beast (a heavy beast is also a long one), so roll z once and reuse it. "upper" in every entry is the clamp ceiling (mean + 3 sd); p95 and p99 are given for "large specimen" and "record specimen" rules.

moonmarked.description: Pale, faintly luminous colouring said to mark a beast born under a full moon.

temperaments.name: Bold
temperaments.hint: Charges in. +1 initiative; Command DC +1 when ordered to retreat.

temperaments.name: Wary
temperaments.hint: Watches first. Advantage on Insight checks to spot Snares; −1 initiative.

temperaments.name: Playful
temperaments.hint: Treats battle as a game. Bond Checks to befriend it are −1 DC.

temperaments.name: Stubborn
temperaments.hint: Command DC +2, but +1 to saves against Charmed and Frightened.

temperaments.name: Gentle
temperaments.hint: Command DC −1; reluctant to attack a foe below half HP.

temperaments.name: Proud
temperaments.hint: Command DC +1; +1 to hit against a foe of a higher stage.

temperaments.name: Curious
temperaments.hint: Advantage on Investigation checks; may wander toward unknown things.

temperaments.name: Lazy
temperaments.hint: Regains 1 extra Qi on any turn it does not move; Command DC +1 for long journeys.

temperaments.name: Restless
temperaments.hint: +5 ft Speed; disadvantage on Endurance checks during rests.

temperaments.name: Devoted
temperaments.hint: Command DC −2 while its Keeper is in sight.

temperaments.name: Sly
temperaments.hint: Advantage on Stealth checks; Command DC +1 when the order is plainly risky.

temperaments.name: Serene
temperaments.hint: Advantage on saves against Frightened; −5 ft Speed.

confluences.name: Kindle
confluences.description: Dry tinder and the first spark; fireflies

confluences.name: Moss
confluences.description: Old stone gone green; the slow life of shrines and riverbanks.

confluences.name: Lacquer
confluences.description: Tree sap hardened to a gleaming shell.

confluences.name: Mangrove
confluences.description: Roots in the tide; brackish shallows and rain-soaked forest.

confluences.name: Ore
confluences.description: Veins of gold and copper in the dark.

confluences.name: Frost
confluences.description: Autumn turning to winter; cold deep water and white rime.

celestial_types.name: Eclipse
celestial_types.description: The moment the sky's lights are swallowed. Belongs to no element and to all of them.
